hotels.title: Elegant Buenos Aires MGallery Escape in Sophisticated Recoleta
hotels.description: Set in elegant Recoleta, this refined Buenos Aires retreat places you near the grand avenues, Belle Époque architecture and leafy paths of Plaza Francia. The Recoleta Cemetery, Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes and the designer boutiques of Avenida Alvear are all within easy reach. Inside, contemporary interiors are paired with an indoor pool, spa and a restaurant showcasing polished Argentine dining. Nearby, savour late-night parrilla at Don Julio in Palermo or browse the handsome bookshops and cafés lining Avenida Santa Fe
